entities.name: Non-Access Stratum
entities.description: The highest stratum of the control plane between UE and AMF over reference point N1, supporting mobility management, session management, and NAS transport functions.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that communicates with the AMF via NAS protocols.

entities.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
entities.description: Network function that terminates the NAS signaling connection with the UE.

entities.name: N1 Reference Point
entities.description: Reference point between UE and AMF for NAS signaling.

entities.name: 5GMM Common Procedures
entities.description: Procedures including authentication, identification, generic UE configuration update, security mode control, and NAS security control.

entities.name: Session Management Procedures
entities.description: Procedures to establish and maintain data connectivity between UE and data network.

entities.name: NAS Transport Procedure
entities.description: Procedure to transport SMS, LPP, LCS, UE policy container, SOR transparent container, and UE parameters update information.

entities.name: NAS Security Contexts
entities.description: Security contexts handling and activation of ciphering and integrity protection when NAS signaling connection is established.

relations.description: NAS operates between UE and AMF.
NAS operates between UE and AMF.
NAS uses the N1 reference point.
NAS security contexts are handled as part of 5GMM common procedures.
